newsitem.title: FRANCE: BNP firms after broker meeting.
newsitem.headline: BNP firms after broker meeting.

text.p: Shares in Banque Nationale de Paris (BNP) were up 2.17 percent at 263.20 francs, on volume of over 688,000 shares around 1030 GMT.
Broker Massonaud confirmed it had hosted a breakfast meeting this morning but gave no details. A BNP official said he believed the bank had not been represented at the meeting.

CSFB in London started coverage of the stock, rating it a "hold", with its analyst expressing concern that BNP's earning's quality might make it hard for it to attain its 10 percent return on equity target.
BNP shares have risen recently on speculation of a link-up with German banks, with market talk throwing up Deutsche Bank and Dresdner Bank as potential partners.
The French bank sector remained undervalued compared to other European valuations, quite apart from any mergers and acquisitions speculation, a bank analyst said. pnt
